# Getting started

This page is a canned response. It is served by the test stub so that web ingestion tests never make an outbound request.

## Installation

Install the package with your package manager of choice:

```bash
npm install example-client
```

## Configuration

The client reads `EXAMPLE_API_URL` from the environment. If it is unset the
client falls back to `http://localhost:8080`, which is what the development
server listens on.

### Timeouts

Every request has a 30 second deadline. A request that exceeds it is retried
once with exponential backoff, then surfaced to the caller as a
`TimeoutError`.

## Next steps

- Read the API reference for the full list of endpoints.
- See the examples directory for a worked integration.
- Report problems on the issue tracker.
